connectionSpecification.description: Reads the channels a Slack bot is a member of, their messages, and the workspace's users through the Slack Web API.

bot_token.description: Bot user OAuth token (xoxb-...) with the scopes channels:read, channels:history and users:read, plus groups:read and groups:history for private channels; sent as a Bearer token.
bot_token.title: Bot token

channel_types.description: Comma-separated conversation types to read, of public_channel, private_channel, mpim and im. Slack's default when empty: public_channel.
channel_types.title: Channel types

start_date.description: Messages posted before it are not read.
start_date.title: Start date
